intent: Complete user-approved numerical corrections; outcomes need not favour the proposed methods
author_validation: pending; no manuscript or rebuttal edits

hardware.Jetson: R1-29/R1-30/R2-15 deferred by user; no substitute measurement

waveforms.FDM: six 20kHz symmetric-time Hamming-LFM; one band per simultaneous sector; no TDM/OFDM
waveforms.CDM: frequency-domain ZC -> IFFT -> 4:1 Kaiser-5 polyphase interpolation -> 4 zero padding samples; no extra temporal taper
waveforms.historical_match: same generation mechanism as current SonarSim generator, not a claim of exact historical-run replication; final paper length 499 is explicit

common_filter.design: firwin, Kaiser beta=8.6, cutoff=50kHz at fs400kHz
common_filter.Tx_primary: identical FIR for all methods; full convolution then compensate 64 samples and take common 2000 sample centre crop; renormalize actual final Tx energy
common_filter.Tx_sensitivity: all methods retain full 2128 sample convolution, same energy normalization; full support not called 5ms
common_filter.Rx: identical FIR on guarded continuous record, compensate known 64 sample delay; no target-tail truncation
common_filter.matched_filter: unit-energy actual Tx pulse through Rx frontend, not unfiltered analytic prototype
common_filter.noise_injection: before common Rx frontend; same processed fs and independent per-receiver CN samples
common_filter.interpretation: numerical common digital bandlimiting, not measured acoustic transducer response or exactly bandlimited waveform

energy: sum over physical transmit elements of squared magnitude of final simultaneous TTD-weighted excitation, including cross terms, is 1; same fs means sample-sum and integral conventions differ by one common dt

metrics.domain: all NMSE/correlation/leakage/CNR use one declared physical range ROI and +/-50deg; never display dB/gamma/TVG values
metrics.guard: strict coordinates +/-0.06m and +/-1deg, common to methods
metrics.fixed_background: 47<=abs(angle)<=50 within fixed ROI, verify no truth collision; do not select after outcomes
metrics.truth_reference: scatterer-support envelope magnitude; not full acoustic ground truth
metrics.Dense_reference: similarity to finite-resolution noise-free Dense reconstruction, distinct from truth error

axes.Doppler: explicit continuous-time query with 8x/16x/32x interpolation convergence; carrier shift included; full-delay peak and fixed local diagnostic both retained
axes.threshold: independent 60 calibration block maxima 95% quantile, higher; no truth-centred candidate search
axes.OMP: 32 random Rx; same actual common waveform/frontend for paired DAS vs OMP; 41 fixed frequency bins; training2/test5; three paired noise seeds; no supplied K; coarse 0.01m/0.5deg, fine0.005m/0.25deg; discrepancy1.3sigma sqrt(M), cap32; training-derived threshold; CPU scope only

reuse_policy: Old receipts unchanged. New numerical data recorded under new protocol. Pure spatial candidate-family audit rerun for traceability, not assumed affected by scalar energy normalization.
approval: User approved executing this correction scope in the chat; manuscript wording remains for author approval
